name: Ava Capital Plc
source: AVA Capital Plc unaudited report for the period ended 30 June 2026, consolidated statements of financial position and of cash flow, filed through the Nigerian Exchange disclosure library. The filing prints N thousands; stored here in absolute Naira.
note: Group column as filed, unaudited, period ended 30 June 2026. Every subtotal in the operating section reproduces the printed figures exactly (710,004 less 94,049,420 plus 83,592,692 plus 4,591,676 equals the printed net cash used in operations of 5,155,048, N thousands) and the Company columns foot exactly. The Group column as printed does not foot by N51,808 thousand between operating plus investing plus financing and the printed net change, so the printed net change is recorded as printed and no derivation was forced onto it. The printed opening cash of 9,386,187 less the printed net change of 2,098,833 gives the printed closing cash of 7,287,354, which agrees with the balance sheet cash line.
reconciliation_note: Net Change in Cash as printed by the source does not equal Operating + Investing + Financing in H1 2026 (printed -2098833000 vs -2047025000). Both figures are as filed and are shown unchanged.
